caption: The drawing depicts a stone statue of a kneeling angel with folded hands, positioned on a rectangular pedestal. The angel has detailed wings extending from its back, and its head is bowed while its arms are crossed over its chest. The figure's features, including the hair, facial details, and folds in its gown, are rendered in shades of brown, gray, and tan, giving a realistic stone-like texture. The pedestal below the angel is rectangular and solid, shaded to accentuate its three-dimensional form. The background is a plain gradient, fading from a light beige near the statue to a slightly darker beige toward the edges, allowing the statue to stand out as the central subject.
title: Figurine
